data.title: Dolutegravir
data.summary: IV Antivirals — Antiretroviral (ART) · Integrase strand transfer inhibitor (INSTI), second generation
data.body:
_Oral · IV Antivirals — Antiretroviral (ART)_

**Class:** Integrase strand transfer inhibitor (INSTI), second generation

## Mechanism of action
- Binds the HIV integrase active site and blocks the strand-transfer step
- So viral DNA cannot integrate into the host chromosome
- High genetic barrier to resistance

## Pharmacokinetics
- Taken once daily with or without food; half-life about 14 h
- Metabolised by UGT1A1 (and CYP3A4 to a lesser extent)

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Part of the preferred first-line ART regimen in India (TLD: tenofovir 300 mg + lamivudine 300 mg + dolutegravir 50 mg once daily) for adults, adolescents and pregnant women
- Children: with abacavir + lamivudine (weight-band dosing)
- Second-line regimens and post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP)

## Dose & formulations
- 50 mg once daily (usually within the TLD tablet)
- 50 mg twice daily if taken with rifampicin or when INSTI resistance is suspected

## Adverse effects
- Insomnia, headache, abnormal dreams, depression (uncommon)
- Weight gain
- Small rise in serum creatinine (blocks tubular creatinine secretion; true kidney function is not reduced)
- Hypersensitivity reactions and hepatotoxicity (rare)
- Early concern about neural tube defects with use at conception; later data show the risk is very small — it is now recommended in pregnancy

## Contraindications
- Dofetilide (raised levels)
- Previous hypersensitivity

## Drug interactions
- Polyvalent cations (antacids with Mg/Al, calcium, iron, zinc supplements) chelate it — take dolutegravir 2 h before or 6 h after
- Rifampicin, carbamazepine, phenytoin lower levels (double the dose with rifampicin; avoid the others)
- Raises metformin levels — limit the metformin dose (about 1 g/day) and monitor

## Monitoring
- CD4 and viral load per programme
- Weight, mood, renal function (expect a small, stable creatinine rise)

## Pregnancy & lactation
Recommended in pregnancy as part of TLD; give folic acid. Compatible with national breastfeeding guidance for women on ART.

## Viva points
- INSTI — blocks integration of viral DNA
- TLD is the preferred first-line regimen in India
- Separate from zinc, iron, calcium or antacids — relevant when we prescribe zinc
- Creatinine rise without real kidney damage

## Note on sources
Khopkar's edition predates dolutegravir, and Wolverton only lists it, so this post follows current NACO/WHO guidance. Please check.

_Sources: Khopkar ch.4 (older edition, before dolutegravir); Wolverton 4e ch.11 (lists the drug); current NACO guidelines. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
